tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don bya tshul snying por dril ba phan bde'i myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ 'dir 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor la brten nas rang gzhan gyi tshogs bsag cing sgrib pa sbyong ba'i tshul gyi cho ga mdor bsdus snying por dril ba la bzhi/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes chog 'phros pa'i don to// dang po la/ legs bsham mchod pa byin gyis brlab// skyabs sems tshad med bsgom pa'o// zhes bzhi las dang po ni/ gnas gtsang zhing dben la yid dang mthun par thugs rje chen po'i snang brnyan bris 'bur gang rigs sam/ ma 'byor na maṇ+ḍa lar me tog gi tshom bu gcig dgod/ gang ltar yang de'i mdun du 'bul gtor dkar zlum dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ gzungs sgrub byed na bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa/ rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal/ me tog rol mo'i bye brag sogs bkod pas mdzes par bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pā ra mi ta/ nā da swa bhā we/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ gsum pa ni/ skyabs yul nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs sems rgyas pa spyi ltar bya ba'am/

bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces skyabs sems sbrel ma ci nus bya/ bzhi pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgom mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bum pa bsgrub// rang gzhan don gnyis bya ba'o// zhes bzhi las dang po ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdakar po las pad+ma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas me tog pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la mtshan dpe'i nyams 'gyur yongs su rdzogs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel pa'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te thim pas yi dam kun 'dus su gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa pad zla'i gdan du gyur pa'i steng du bla ma nyid rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i bla ma la thim pa las bla ma kun 'dus su gyur/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po'i mthar yi ge drug ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad yi ge drug ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas gsang sngags kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/ spyi bo'i bla ma/ rang yi dam/ rang gi lus kyi bye brag dang*/ snod bcud thams cad thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'u ru ru sgrogs par bsams la/ sgra grag stong dbyer med la sems gtad de/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla/ thun las ldang ba na yi ge brgya pas sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ mdun rten a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po las pad+ma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas me tog pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la mtshan dpe'i nyams 'gyur yongs su rdzogs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yang dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol// oṃ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye his spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te thim pas yi dam kun 'dus su gyur/

slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa pad zla'i gdan du gyur pa'i steng du bla ma nyid rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i bla ma la thim pa las bla ma kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/ de nas yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas bsag sbyang spel gsum bya ba'i thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rang dang sems can thams cad lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa 'bul ba sogs bsag sbyang gi las la 'jug par bsams la/ yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi// 'char ka'i pad+mo kha 'bus bye 'dra ba// lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas// lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal// bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyis// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor byin brlabs pa// bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// skyob pa sangs rgyas kun dang gnyis su med// legs gsung sgron me dam pa chos kyi gsung*// ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa'i bcom ldan 'das// 'gro ba kun la bu gcig lta bur brtse// lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las can// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/

ji snyed su dag nas/ bdag gis bstod ces pa'i bar bzang spyod ltar bya'o// mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa 'khor bcas mchod// oṃ gu ru ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ sil snyan rnams dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da rnams sbyar ba so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te mchod pa'i mthar/ dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs brjod la rol mo bya/ me tog dam pa nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// zhes pa'i bar bzang spyod ltar dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bi d+ya badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇe badz+re/ sarba karma a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod cing rol mo bya/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma'am/ bdun pa sogs spyi ltar la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ yi dam kun 'dus 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ skabs su spro na/ bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sbyar/ grangs gsog na/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brgya tshar sogs dbul/ sdig pa bshags pa sogs yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nas/ byang chub phyir bsngo'o'i bar bzang spyod ltar bya/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad yi ge drug ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas gsang sngags kun 'dus su gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa'i mos pas yi ge drug ma ci nus bzla/ ༈ /mjug tu gtor ma la chab bran te bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/

oṃ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ bsdu na bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i phyag mdzub las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la yi ge drug ma ci nus bzlas mthar/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐ dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs bzla'o// rgyas par spro na bsang sbyangs sogs gong ltar la/ chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po las pad+ma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas me tog pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la mtshan dpe'i nyams 'gyur yongs su rdzogs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bum pa'i lha la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te thim pas yi dam kun 'dus su gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa pad zla'i gdan du gyur pa'i steng du bla ma nyid rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i bla ma la thim pa las bla ma kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/ oṃ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ gzungs thag bzung la/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad yi ge drug ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas gsang sngags kun 'dus su gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song*/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la sngags bzla/ mthar mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces nongs pa bshags/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ tshogs bsag rkyang pa tsam gyi skabs bum pa bsgrub ma grub kyang rung ngo*// bzhi pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rten me long ngos su shar pa la bum pa'i chus khrus bya zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ 'gro ba'i sgron me spyan ras gzigs dbang la// dri zhim bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis khrus gsol bas// 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis dri ma rnam bsal nas// dri bral sku gsum brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /oṃ sarba sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa dus mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba sogs/ khrus ras kyis sku phyi zhing*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/

chu de bum par blugs la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa gtso 'khor gsum byon pa'i yum yi ge drug ma'i phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad bkrus shing gang bas/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dag skye med chos sku mngon du gyur par bsams la/ yi ge drug ma lan gsum du brjod cing bum chu 'thung zhing khrus bya/ gzhan don byed na skabs 'dir bsgrub bya thams cad la yi ge drug ma bzla bzhin du gzungs chab blud cing khrus bya ba'am/ spro na bkru byabs srung gsum spyi ltar byas kyang rung*/ gshin po la phan gdags par 'dod na'ang cho ga rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyang skabs 'dir sbyar ro// de ltar bgyis pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi zhing*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa sogs phan yon dpag tu med la/ khrus chab dang byin rten sel med rigs sbyar ba'i ril bu mi dang dud 'gro sogs la sbyin pa dang*/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor 'dor ba sogs 'phags pa'i phrin las spel ba'i thabs la brtson par bya'o// gsum pa rjes la/ nongs pa bshags shing rjes bsdu bya// bsngo smon gdab cing shis pa brjod// ces bzhi las/ dang po ni/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces nongs pa bshags/ gnyis pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu// 'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor/

rten med na/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de'ang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur/ slar yang rang skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes brjod cing gnas gsum bsrung*/ gsum pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /thugs rje chen po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang*/ spro na/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sogs bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam sogs rgyas par gdab/ bzhi pa ni/ che ba'i che mchog gam/ ston mchog dam pa sogs zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra sbyar ro// de las cung zad rgyas par spro na thog mar brgyud 'debs dang*/ skyabs sems kyi rjes rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor khrid kyi ngag 'don ltar/ phyag 'tshal gyi skabs su rgyal sras rin po che thogs med bzang po'i gsung thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa nyer lnga pa dang*/ mchod pa'i nyer spyod kyi rjes/ rgyal srid bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga sogs mchod phreng spyi ltar/ bshags pa'i skabs zla ba grags pa'i smre bshags sogs sbyar na'ang legs par 'gyur ro// //bzhi pa zhar byung 'gro phan ma ṇi ril bu bsgrub pa'i tshul mdo tsam bshad na/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang ni// phan yon mdor bsdus smos pa'o// zhes bzhi las dang po ni/

sngar gzungs sgrub byas pa'i bum chu yod na legs/ gang ltar yang 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel dang*/ bla ma gong ma'i byin rten sel med 'bras gsum bzang drug sogs bzang sman bcas 'bras sam/ nas dkar rjan 'thag gam/ bag phye la gzhi byas te dri bzang gi chus ril bur dril/ ril chags cung zad byas la grib mar bskam/ gsher thag chod pa dang mtshal lam li khris na bza' gsol/ ril chags 'them par byas la bum par blug kha rgyan dang mgul chings kyis spras te spos kyis bdugs la stegs bu'i dbus su gzhag gzungs thag gdags/ mdun du zlum gtor dkar po dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod sogs kyis bskor/ 'byor na gdugs 'phan rgyal mtshan sogs kyang bkod pas mdzes par brgyan/ rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal/ me tog khrus bum/ rol mo'i bye brag sogs 'du bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung bdag bskyed kyi gdan bsdu ba'i bar grub rjes/ mdun gyi bum pa ril bu dang bcas pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ de'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ril bu rnams hrīḥdakar po las pad+ma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros sogs nas yan lag bdun pa'i bar mdun bskyed ji lta bar bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs gzungs thag nas bzung la/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad yi ge drug ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas gsang sngags kun 'dus su gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song*/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad dang*/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi bcud dang dwangs ma dge mtshan ma lus pa 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bum pa'i lha la thim pas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar bar gyur par bsams la yi ge drug ma gtso bor bzla/ shes shing spro na don zhags dang*/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs sogs ci rigs bzlas kyang legs/ sgrub grogs yod na bza' btung dang spyod lam sogs kyi tshe gzungs thag res mos su bzung la bzlas pa rgyun mi 'chad par bya/ gsum pa ni/ thun bsdu ba na/ yi ge brgya pa dbyangs gsal rten snying rnams bzlas pas sngags kyi lhag chad bskang zhing nus pa spel ba dang*/ byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par bya/ mdun bskyed ltar gtor ma dbul/ khrus gsol/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ nyer bsdu/ bsngo smon bkra shis bcas gong ltar bya/ thun phyi ma rnams la bum lha sngar yod gsal gdab kyi tshul du bskyed/ de lta bu'i sgo nas ril bu las 'od dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri bzang po 'thul ba dang*/ rgya cher 'phel ba sogs rtags mthong ba'i bar ram/ zhag bdun sogs su bsgrub/ grol rgyu'i thun gyi mjug tu/ nongs bshags kyi rjes/ bskyed pa'i lha yongs su gyur pa las grub pa'i ril bu 'od 'bar ba'i rnam pa mthong thos dran reg thams cad grol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/

'dir ni rten dang sogs brtan bzhugs nyer bsdu/ bsngo smon bkra shis bcas rgyas par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa chen mo las/ ril bu zos pa tsam gyis ni// nad rnams thams cad rnam par 'jig /gang zhig ril bu de dag bsten// ril bu thig le rtag byed la// de bzhin gshegs kun dgongs par mdzod// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang*// de nyid rigs la rtag tu ni// mchog sbyin dus kun gzigs par mdzad// bsod nams phung po stobs dag ni// nyi ma re re sogs par byed// 'jig rten pa yi bde spyad cing*// 'jig rten pha rol shin tu bde// tshe brje ba ni 'phos nas su// bde ba can du mod la 'gro// gang dang gang du skye ba der// tshe rabs rtag tu tshe rabs dran// lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin che// gnod sbyin bya bas yongs bskor cing*// g.yel ba med par nyin mtshan du// dus kun du ni srung ba dang*// skyob dang sbed dang srung bar byed// ces dang*/ ril bu gang la yod pa ni// phyir mi ldog par lung bstan cing*// mgon po sa bcu dag la gnas// rtag tu mchod rten gyur pa ste// sku gdung snying po'i bdag nyid can// rtag tu sangs rgyas bdag nyid 'gyur// ces dang*/ril bu mthong ba tsam gyis ni// sdug bsngal kun las rab tu grol// sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'chod// sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag /de ni ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur// phyir zhing gnas mchog zhi ba thob// ces sogs rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyi sman sbyar zhing*/ sngags dang phyag rgyas mngon par dbang bskur te byin gyis brlabs pa'i grub pa'i ril bu'i yon tan bsngags pa mtha' yas par gsungs pa nyid skabs 'dir yang mtshungs par shes par bya'o// gang dag sngags gsar ma'i phyogs la ma ṇi ril bu sgrub pa'i khungs gsal bar med pas rigs mthun byis blo 'drid byed nyi tshe tsam du zad ces gsungs pa'ang snang mod/

grub chen dzai tā ris mdzad par grags pa'i thugs rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs las dmigs kyis bsal bar ma zad/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams su grub pa'i ril bu bsgrub tshul rgya cher 'byung ba dang*/ bde kye sogs las skye ba bdun pa'i sha dang bdud rtsi ril bu la brten nas dngos grub mchog bsgrub pa'i tshul dang*/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rgya gar gyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i ril sgrub dang*/ gzhan yang ku ru ku l+le'i don kun grub pa'i ril bu sogs tshul 'di la brten nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rab 'byams bsgrub tshul rgya cher gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun pa nyid kyi phyir khungs med pa'ang ma yin no// des na 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter chen gyi rnal 'byor zab mo la gcig tu gzhol ba rnams kyis tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas kyang rang gzhan gyi phan bde rgyas pa'i thabs la brtson par bya'o// zhes grub chen tshem+bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i gdams pa dang rjes su 'brel bar rang gzhan gyi don bya tshul mdor bsdus snying por dril ba 'di'ang*/ bya bral ma ṇi ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos yig cha snga ma 'ga' zhig gi don gyi snying po'i bcud phyungs te bklag pas grub par bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la mngon du byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
